goodsServices.description:
(1) Chemical pre-treatment coatings for aluminum sheet, castings, and extrusions; coatings for aluminum sheet, castings, and extrusions 
(2) Aluminum alloys, titanium alloys, aluminum alloy plates, aluminum forgings, and blocks used for making molds and tooling aluminum blocks for use in manufacturing of moulds and tooling equipment; building window walls made primarily of metal, metal rivets, small items of metal hardware, namely, nuts, screws, bolts, washers, springs; metal fasteners, namely, quarter turn fasteners and panel locking fasteners; screw inserts of common metal; metal screw inserts; aluminum building components, namely, doors and frames, vestibules and entrances, wall facing panels and curtain walls, windows, sun control louvers; building materials, namely, aluminum soffit, fascia, doors, siding, shutters, windows, trim, columns, screens, grilles and railings; metal building materials, namely aluminum soffit, fascia, doors, siding, gutters, downspouts, shutters, windows, flashing sheet, roofing shingles, trim shingles, columns, flag poles, screens, grilles and railings; drain pipes of metal, pipes of metal for central heating installations, gutter pipes of metal, metal penstock pipes, metal pipes for liquid and gas transfer, water-pipes of metal, branching tubes of metal for pipelines 
(3) Waste water treatment equipment, namely water and waste water treatment systems comprised of water treatment equipment, namely, solids removal and anaerobic treatment cells in the nature of treatment tanks that remove metals and break down and separate organic matter in the water, a passive engineered aerated wetland, which utilizes vegetation for further treatment of organics and removal of nitrogen, and a cell housing bauxite-based technology that disinfects and polishes the water 
(4) Wheels for commercial vehicles; components for land vehicles, namely, structural parts for automobiles and trucks; components for aircraft, namely, structural parts for aircraft and aircraft engines; ceramic cores used as components for aircraft engines 
(5) Non-metallic building materials, namely vinyl siding, vinyl soffit, windows, shutters, window trim, door trim, undersill trim and installation accessories, namely J-channels 
(6) Ceramic cores, wax patterns, and plastic patterns for metal casting

(1) Aluminum treatment process for the pretreatment of aluminum used in manufacturing; pretreatment of aluminum automotive and aerospace components prior to their assembly and joining to enhance bonding ability; additive manufacturing services in the field of aerospace applications
